tokens.name: n-0

tokens.name: n-100

tokens.name: n-200

tokens.name: n-300
tokens.usage: Hairlines on paper where a glass edge is not enough.

tokens.name: n-400
tokens.usage: Strong borders on paper: the edge of an input at rest.

tokens.name: n-500
tokens.usage: Subtle text in the ink theme. Disabled marks.

tokens.name: n-600

tokens.name: n-700

tokens.name: n-800

tokens.name: n-900
tokens.usage: The warm charcoal the ink glass tints toward.

tokens.name: n-950
tokens.usage: Primary ink on paper.

tokens.name: n-1000
tokens.usage: The base ground of the ink theme, under the bloom field.

tokens.name: forest-50
tokens.usage: The quietest forest wash, behind a reviewed row.

tokens.name: forest-100
tokens.usage: Forest hover fill on paper.

tokens.name: forest-200
tokens.usage: Forest borders on paper.

tokens.name: forest-300
tokens.usage: Forest text in the ink theme.

tokens.name: forest-400
tokens.usage: Hovered forest text and icons in the ink theme.

tokens.name: forest-500
tokens.usage: The structural hue. Opportunity, organized. Carries white at 6.5:1.

tokens.name: forest-600
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a forest fill, and forest text on paper.

tokens.name: forest-700
tokens.usage: Deep forest for charts and dense fills.

tokens.name: forest-800
tokens.usage: Deepest forest block, for covers.

tokens.name: forest-950
tokens.usage: The forest-tinted surface in the ink theme.

tokens.name: verm-50
tokens.usage: The quietest vermilion wash, behind an interview row or a field in error.

tokens.name: verm-100
tokens.usage: Vermilion hover fill on paper.

tokens.name: verm-200
tokens.usage: Vermilion borders on paper.

tokens.name: verm-300
tokens.usage: Vermilion text in the ink theme.

tokens.name: verm-400
tokens.usage: Hovered vermilion text and icons in the ink theme.

tokens.name: verm-500
tokens.usage: The signal hue. Success, accelerated. Carries white at 4.6:1. One moment per view.

tokens.name: verm-600
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a vermilion fill, and vermilion text on paper.

tokens.name: verm-700
tokens.usage: Deep vermilion for charts and dense fills.

tokens.name: verm-800
tokens.usage: Deepest vermilion block, for covers.

tokens.name: verm-950
tokens.usage: The vermilion-tinted surface in the ink theme.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Layer 0. The flat ground the bloom field is painted on. Nothing sits directly on it.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Layer 2. A tonal container that sits above the ground as opaque colour rather than glass.

tokens.name: surface-high
tokens.usage: Layer 3. The raised surface of a menu, a dialog, or a selected row.

tokens.name: bloom-forest
tokens.usage: The large soft forest form in the bloom field, blurred at blur-bloom. Glass has nothing to refract without it.

tokens.name: bloom-verm
tokens.usage: The smaller vermilion form in the bloom field, always the quieter of the two.

tokens.name: bloom-warm
tokens.usage: The neutral form that keeps the field from reading as two coloured blobs.

tokens.name: glass-sheer
tokens.usage: The lightest glass, for large panels holding other glass. Never put text directly on it.

tokens.name: glass-soft
tokens.usage: The default surface: cards, list rows, tiles. Carries headings and short labels.

tokens.name: glass-dense
tokens.usage: Reading glass: forms, flyouts, dialogs, and any panel carrying a paragraph. Required wherever muted text appears.

tokens.name: glass-solid
tokens.usage: The opaque stand-in wherever backdrop blur is unsupported or the viewer asks for reduced transparency. Every glass surface declares this first.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px inner highlight along the top of a glass surface. This is the token that makes it read as a pane rather than a fade.

tokens.name: glass-ring
tokens.usage: The 1px ring around the rest of a glass surface, quieter than the top edge.

tokens.name: glass-hover
tokens.usage: The extra lightening laid over a glass surface on hover, instead of a separate fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a dialog, blurred at blur-scrim so the page reads as out of focus.

tokens.name: rule-hairline
tokens.usage: A separator inside a glass panel, where a second pane would be too much.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: The resting edge of an input. Reads at 3:1 against both the field fill and the page in either theme, which is what a control boundary has to do; one step lighter does not.

tokens.name: rule-focus
tokens.usage: The focus outline, 2px with a 2px offset. Identical in both themes, and never removed.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy. The only text allowed on glass-soft.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting sentences. Needs glass-dense beneath it.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata: company, location, applied date. Needs glass-dense beneath it.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and timestamps. Needs glass-dense beneath it.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons drawn on a filled forest or vermilion control. Fixed in both themes, because the brand fills are the same colour in both: a value that followed the ground would put near black on mid forest in the ink theme.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Inline links, underlined by default. Colour alone never marks a link.

tokens.name: brand-forest
tokens.usage: The structural half of the line. Navigation, verification, filters, anything already put in order.

tokens.name: brand-verm
tokens.usage: The momentum half of the line. Deadlines closing, interviews, unread counts, anything waiting on the viewer.

tokens.name: action-fill
tokens.usage: The ground of the one primary button on a view. Solid, never glass.

tokens.name: action-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed ground of a primary button.

tokens.name: attention-fill
tokens.usage: The selected filter mark, the unread count, the closing-soon mark. One per view. The 600 step rather than 500 so a white count on it clears 4.5:1.

tokens.name: attention-text
tokens.usage: Vermilion text that has to be read rather than noticed.

tokens.name: attention-wash
tokens.usage: A vermilion tint laid over a glass row that needs the viewer, keeping the pane translucent.

tokens.name: active-wash
tokens.usage: A forest tint laid over a selected or reviewed glass row.

tokens.name: state-open-bg
tokens.usage: SUBMITTED. A neutral tint: received is not yet news.

tokens.name: state-open-text
tokens.usage: SUBMITTED tag label.

tokens.name: state-active-bg
tokens.usage: UNDER_REVIEW. Forest, because the record is moving through the system.

tokens.name: state-active-text
tokens.usage: UNDER_REVIEW tag label.

tokens.name: state-waiting-bg
tokens.usage: INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED. Vermilion, because it is waiting on the applicant.

tokens.name: state-waiting-text
tokens.usage: INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED tag label.

tokens.name: state-offer-bg
tokens.usage: OFFER_EXTENDED. The only solid tag, because it is the only state that demands an answer.

tokens.name: state-offer-text
tokens.usage: OFFER_EXTENDED tag label.

tokens.name: state-won-bg
tokens.usage: OFFER_ACCEPTED. Quiet forest: the loud moment was the offer, not the confirmation.

tokens.name: state-won-text
tokens.usage: OFFER_ACCEPTED tag label.

tokens.name: state-closed-bg
tokens.usage: REJECTED, OFFER_DECLINED and WITHDRAWN. All three are endings, and none is an alarm.

tokens.name: state-closed-text
tokens.usage: Ended tag label, quieter than every live state.

tokens.name: feedback-error-text
tokens.usage: Field errors and validation summaries. Vermilion doubles as the error hue: an error is attention required.

tokens.name: feedback-error-rule
tokens.usage: The left marker on an error summary, and the border of a field in error.

tokens.name: feedback-ok-text
tokens.usage: Confirmation text and success marks.

families.serif: "Fraunces Variable", Fraunces, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.sans: "Inter Variable", Inter, "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The positioning line at full size. One per page, never bolded: the face carries the weight.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: Your next role is on the record

styles.name: display-italic
styles.usage: One emphasised word inside a display line. The only italic in the system.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: The largest sans heading, for dashboards.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Card titles, posting titles, dialog headings.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The uppercase label above a block. Set it uppercase in the markup, never with a CSS transform.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Apply once, then follow every application.
styles.usage: Marketing paragraphs. Hold the measure to 70 characters.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: This posting asks for a transcript and an authorisation letter.
styles.usage: The default paragraph everywhere in the product.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense rows, table cells, helper text under a field.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and footnotes. The smallest size allowed for a real sentence.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Every button label, at every size.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The headline number on a dashboard or a funnel stage.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Inline figures in a stat row or a filter count.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Status constants and identifiers. Developer views only, and always on a solid well.

spacing.note: A 4px base on an 8px rhythm. Glass needs more air than an opaque interface: panes want visible ground between them so the field can be seen doing its work.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a state dot and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between tags in a row, and between a label and its control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a compact row, and the gap between glass rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The default gap, and the padding of a list row.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and flyout padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sub-sections, and the padding of a large pane.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between major sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between page sections on marketing pages.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: The air above and below a display line.

radius.note: The Material 3 shape scale, and the only shape scale in the project: --m3-shape-* in frontend/src/styles/m3.css aliases these names rather than carrying numbers of its own, so a change here moves both. Generous throughout. A soft pane with a tight corner reads as a mistake, so nothing but a full-bleed rule is square.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: State tags, filter chips, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List rows, small tiles, and the shape a pill button relaxes into while it is pressed.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, flyouts, menus, the rail.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels, dialogs, and the soft and dense glass panes.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero panes and the marketing surfaces behind a display line.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: True circles: avatars, state dots, unread counts.

blur.note: Each glass fill has one blur that belongs with it. A blur without its fill leaves text sitting on whatever happens to be behind it.

tokens.name: blur-sheer
tokens.usage: With glass-sheer, on large containing panels.

tokens.name: blur-soft
tokens.usage: With glass-soft, on cards and list rows. The default.

tokens.name: blur-dense
tokens.usage: With glass-dense, on forms, flyouts and dialogs.

tokens.name: blur-scrim
tokens.usage: On the scrim behind a dialog.

tokens.name: blur-bloom
tokens.usage: On every form in the bloom field. The blooms are never drawn sharp.

shadow.note: Soft and wide rather than tight and dark. A glass pane is held up by its highlight edge as much as by its shadow, so both are always applied together.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Anything that does not float: tags, inline controls, a row inside a pane.

tokens.name: shadow-soft-sm
tokens.usage: A resting card or list row.

tokens.name: shadow-soft-md
tokens.usage: A hovered card, and a sticky header once the page has scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-soft-lg
tokens.usage: Flyouts, menus and the notification panel.

tokens.name: shadow-soft-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the interview scheduler.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-edge
tokens.usage: The highlight edge and ring, applied to every glass surface alongside its drop shadow. Without it a pane reads as a fade rather than as glass.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled control, which keeps its place and says why in its title.
